AI Video Maker Online — first release!

- Instantly turn up to five product photos and a logo into high-quality MP4 videos using simple prompts.
- No manual editing or timeline needed — just upload and describe your desired result.
- Automated cloud GPU rendering delivers downloadable 1080p videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports exporting in mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, and aac formats.
- Easy session setup and 100 free credits for first-time users.
- Handles common video workflows: batch processing, quick edits, iterative previews, and exports.
